description.en: The Cancer Virtual Lab Ontology (CVL-O) is an OWL 2 ontology for representing the oncological care pathway of patients from real-world hospital data: diagnosis and TNM staging, therapies and drug administrations, adverse events, biomarkers, genomic variants, laboratory tests, body measurements, symptom assessments, treatment response and clinical services. It is aligned with HL7 FHIR and reuses standard biomedical terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, NCIt, ICD-10, ATC). CVL-O is the semantic foundation of the Cancer Virtual Lab project, a collaboration between the University of Bologna, IRCCS Istituto Romagnolo per lo Studio dei Tumori (IRST) "Dino Amadori", Aivolution Srl and IFAB (International Foundation Big Data and Artificial Intelligence for Human Development), and underpins the Cancer Virtual Lab knowledge graph.

comments.en: The clinical definitions (skos:definition) of CVL-O 1.1.0 have been reviewed and validated by the biomedical team of the Cancer Virtual Lab project.

ECOG Grade 0, indicating the patient is fully active and able to carry on all pre-disease performance without restriction.
ECOG Grade 1, indicating the patient is restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory.
ECOG Grade 2, indicating the patient is ambulatory and capable of all selfcare but unable to carry out any work activities.
ECOG Grade 3, indicating the patient is capable of only limited selfcare, confined to bed or chair more than 50% of waking hours.
ECOG Grade 4, indicating the patient is completely disabled, cannot carry on any selfcare, and is totally confined to bed or chair.
Pathological Node (pN) category, indicating lymph node spread based on definitive surgical pathology.
